{"draft": "Everest Group third-quarter profit slips on reserve development

Everest Group reported third-quarter net income of $233 million, or $6.12 per diluted share, compared with $255 million, or $6.09 per diluted share, in the same period a year earlier.

The company's net operating income declined to $290 million, or $7.62 per diluted share, from $316 million, or $7.54 per diluted share, a year earlier. Everest posted an annualized total shareholder return of 14.2%, along with an annualized net income return on equity of 6.0% and an annualized net operating income return on equity of 7.4%.

Book value per share stood at $381.04 at September 30, 2026, compared with $379.83 at December 31, 2025. The company repurchased $474 million of common shares during the quarter.

Gross written premium from Core businesses slipped 4.0% year over year to $3.7 billion. Within that total, Reinsurance Treaty premium fell 6.2% on a comparable basis, while Global Wholesale & Specialty premium climbed 3.2% on a comparable basis.

Core businesses posted a combined ratio of 105.8%. Everest recorded net unfavorable reserve development of approximately $268 million in prior year loss reserves, and the Group recorded a pre-tax underwriting loss of $223 million.

Net investment income rose to $634 million from $540 million in the prior year quarter, helped by higher alternative investment returns."}
